first_assertion_stability.measures: whether each subject's FIRST verdict assertion was ever subsequently revised. It does NOT establish that no later turn had stable verdict coverage.
first_assertion_stability.note: A null value means at least one first assertion was later revised; it does NOT mean no later stable turn exists.

readiness_semantics.does_not_measure: independent factual sufficiency of the evidence
readiness_semantics.measures: first recorded verdict-assertion coverage over R1..R10
readiness_semantics.refinement_correction: A subject whose verdict was later REFINEd means its first assertion was not final; the first-assertion turn therefore cannot be treated as a defensible synthesis point for that subject.
